CodeDeploy deployments
This topic provides information about the components and workflow of deployments in CodeDeploy.
    The deployment process varies, depending on the compute platform or deployment method (Lambda,
    Amazon ECS, EC2/On-Premises, or through AWS CloudFormation) that you use for your deployments.
